personality_one_liner: A professional, high-clarity command center that puts fleet operations and financial metrics first without feeling cluttered.

spacing.rule: Generous padding around content, clear grouping. No cramped cards. Consistent margins.

do's: Sticky horizontal date strip in timeline view

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: High-level overview of fleet performance with a timeline of recent/upcoming trips.

states.empty: Illustration of a parked truck or empty box indicating no trips for the selected day.
states.error: Error message with a retry button to fetch dashboard data.

screens.layout: Single column. Top section: 2 KPI blocks side-by-side (Total Trips, Revenue in INR). Below: A sticky horizontal scrollable Timeline picker (-30 to +30 days) where the active date uses a brandPrimary pill. Below timeline: Vertical list of trip cards for the selected day. The trip cards should clearly display 'From', 'To', Driver, and Vehicle data. Pad the bottom for the tab bar.

screens.name: Trips
screens.purpose: Complete log of all trips with adding capabilities.

states.empty: Illustration showing no trips logged yet.
states.error: Failed to load trips banner with retry.

screens.layout: Header with Segmented Control (All / Past / Future). Vertical FlatList of trip cards. Sticky primary CTA 'Add Trip' fixed at bottom right above the safe area. The Add Trip flow can be a full-screen modal with form fields.

screens.name: Fleet
screens.purpose: Manage the transport company's core assets: trucks and drivers.

states.empty: Empty state illustration with primary action to 'Add your first vehicle/driver'.

screens.layout: Top sticky Segmented Control (Vehicles | Drivers). Vehicles view: Grid/List of cards containing real truck photos, registration number, and model. Drivers view: List rows with driver avatar, name, and contact number. Include a sticky CTA 'Add Vehicle/Driver' based on active tab.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Manage personal contact details for the single user.

states.error: Toast or inline error for failed updates.

screens.layout: Clean list view. Top: Large initials avatar inside a brandTertiary circle. Form fields for Mobile Number and Email below. 'Save Changes' primary button pinned at the bottom.

dashboard_hero_bg.alt: Overhead shot of semi-trucks parked demonstrating transportation logistics

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly apply the Navy Blue (#1E3A8A) palette as the user explicitly requested a 'Professional blue/navy theme' for their logistics app, overriding the standard anti-blue rule.
Format all currency values natively as INR (₹) utilizing Intl.NumberFormat('en-IN', ...).

Timeline View implementation: Create a horizontally scrolling FlatList for the dates ranging from today-30 to today+30. The active selected date should update the vertical list of trips directly underneath it.

For Vehicle and Driver creation forms, integrate `expo-image-picker`. Configure it to return base64 strings (`base64: true`) for Vehicle Photos, RC Documents, and License Documents, as MongoDB will store these directly.
Do not exceed font weight 500 for Plus Jakarta Sans; rely on size scaling for typographic hierarchy.
Ensure 'Add Trip', 'Add Vehicle', and 'Add Driver' CTAs are sticky at the bottom of the screen (or bottom-right as a FAB with glassmorphism), floating above scrollable content.
Include empty states on Dashboard, Trips, and Fleet screens using the provided Unsplash/Pexels URLs combined with vertical gradient scrims to maintain contrast if text overlays are used.
